purpose: Implemented A01 traceability with explicit synthetic and hardware evidence boundaries

audit_findings.title: active unscheduled peer omitted from gross capacity
audit_findings.disposition_and_acceptance: **Retain/adapt.** The old Tesla pseudo-peer is removed, but a manually started, auto-OFF or already running Shelly/Easee peer still consumes real capacity. Keep gross capacity, net live headroom and forecast household subtraction distinct; reserve each peer exactly once, including scheduled→running transitions. Preserve the 10 kWh/one-hour witness with 9 A remaining (6.21 kWh), adapting the peer to the new physical topology. Test already-throttled load, unknown stop/target, stale peer, changing household reference and restart. A currently uncontrolled peer must neither vanish nor be subtracted twice.
audit_findings.completion_evidence: See docs/audit/A01.md and named synthetic regressions; hardware verification has not occurred.
audit_findings.clean_start_and_removal_notes: Current native formats only. Only v0.7.5 easee.csv/st-mq.csv import compatibility is preserved.
audit_findings.disposition: Implemented. Joint planning reserves actual running/automatic-OFF/post-target peers once; configured gross budget is distinct from live net allowance.

audit_findings.title: incorrect optimizer exactness claim
audit_findings.disposition_and_acceptance: **Retain, with explicit objective change.** The old heuristic had a feasible 4.484-cent period-penalized alternative to its 4.588-cent result. New two-job planning requires independent cost/feasibility validation, not extrapolation of that single-job heuristic. Implement an exact or bounded method for a declared discretization/constraint model, or explicitly report heuristic status and measured gaps. Preserve the old witness as historical evidence; test the new cash-cost objective separately as required by §2.2. Include negative/zero prices, fractional requirements/final intervals, variable headroom, minimum run/gap constraints, different deadlines and solver timeout. No unsupported global/continuous-time optimality claim.
audit_findings.completion_evidence: See docs/audit/A01.md and named synthetic regressions; hardware verification has not occurred.
audit_findings.clean_start_and_removal_notes: Current native formats only. Only v0.7.5 easee.csv/st-mq.csv import compatibility is preserved.
audit_findings.disposition: Implemented with a deliberate bounded-search contract. Cash-cost objective, declared slot/current model, beam bound, independent relaxed lower bound and candidate gap; no claim of global continuous-time optimality.

audit_findings.title: stale overlapping price partitions
audit_findings.disposition_and_acceptance: **Retain.** Canonicalize authoritative quarter/hour revisions without double pricing or losing uncovered current publication scope. The 10 kWh × revised 40 ct/kWh witness must yield **400 cents**, not 100. Test partial revisions, gaps, negative rates, midnight and same-current-schema cache restart. Incompatible development caches are not converted.

audit_findings.disposition: Implemented. Latest-publication canonical interval sweep preserves uncovered scope. Revised 10 kWh at 40 cents yields 400 cents; negative prices and gaps retain meaning.

audit_findings.title: stale negative connection evidence
audit_findings.disposition_and_acceptance: **Retain.** An old Easee pilot A must not overrule a newer charging mode, and vice versa. Reconcile competing source clocks/semantics across streams, REST and recovery. Equal-time conflict becomes uncertainty, not a fabricated unplug. Test the downstream effects on session identity, progress, cost and schedule ownership—not just the normalized Boolean. Apply equivalent coherent-state handling to Shelly's plug/working-state evidence.
audit_findings.completion_evidence: See docs/audit/A01.md and named synthetic regressions; hardware verification has not occurred.

audit_findings.disposition: Implemented. Newest coherent Easee pilot/mode evidence governs connection, equal-clock conflict stays unknown. Physical Shelly work-state boundaries cannot be overwritten by an older source clock.

audit_findings.title: physical reassociation reuses old state/ownership
audit_findings.disposition_and_acceptance: **Retain and extend for current associations.** Scope sessions, progress, costs, checkpoints and ownership to provider/device/root and plug epoch. Test device, broker, topic and vehicle-ID changes and switching back within the current contract. Never issue replacement-device cleanup from another association’s ownership. Start the new EVSE design fresh; no old C2 preference/history or unscoped-ownership migration.
audit_findings.completion_evidence: See docs/audit/A01.md and named synthetic regressions; hardware verification has not occurred.

audit_findings.disposition: Implemented. State/ownership is scoped to physical provider association and plug epoch. MQTT broker/root, model/firmware/phase reassociation withdraws old authority; old orphan ownership is not revived after switching back.

audit_findings.title: disconnect/reconnect edges lost between ticks
audit_findings.disposition_and_acceptance: **Retain/adapt.** Persist genuine attributable boundary events before overwriting latest fields, including pre-SUBACK buffering. Cover false→true within one tick, multiple edges, a restart between edges, retained negatives and missing primary EVSE evidence. The old Tesla negative-edge path becomes vehicle/assignment corroboration under the new physical-EVSE lifecycle, not an unconditional authority to close any charger. Close each real epoch once; never inherit old credited energy into a proven new plug session.
audit_findings.completion_evidence: See docs/audit/A01.md and named synthetic regressions; hardware verification has not occurred.

audit_findings.disposition: Implemented. Ordered bounded pre-SUBACK events and durable Tesla/physical work-state boundary history preserve false-to-true edges. A vehicle edge corroborates the relevant identity; it cannot blindly terminate C2 physical metering.

audit_findings.title: unhealthy Tesla logger ignored
audit_findings.disposition_and_acceptance: **Retain as vehicle-evidence quality.** MQTT connectivity is not vehicle logger health. Share transport/upstream/field admission semantics across identity, assigned vehicle envelope, UI and planning. Preserve labeled last-known values while withdrawing unsupported operational certainty; do not turn an unhealthy feed into zero demand or use it to revive a duplicate Tesla electrical path. Test false/stale/retained health, asleep-but-healthy, independent field updates and recovery without falsifying measurement clocks.
audit_findings.completion_evidence: See docs/audit/A01.md and named synthetic regressions; hardware verification has not occurred.

audit_findings.disposition: Implemented. MQTT admission, explicit live logger health and field quality are separate. Healthy sleeping vehicles can supply evidence; unhealthy/retained/stale health withdraws operative fields while retaining labeled last-known facts.

audit_findings.title: remote Tesla voltage becomes home supply
audit_findings.disposition_and_acceptance: **Retire the bad forward fallback; retain regression.** Local supply/EVSE electrical evidence must be installation-associated. A Tesla charging elsewhere at 240 V must never fill missing home phase voltage/current. Keep unknown home voltage unavailable/provisional. Cover away/unknown location, stale retained data, a Tesla on either local charger and asymmetric phase voltages. Removing C2's Tesla UI alone does not prove the runtime sharing path was removed.
audit_findings.completion_evidence: See docs/audit/A01.md and named synthetic regressions; hardware verification has not occurred.

audit_findings.title: Tesla-on-Easee diagnostic labeled C2
audit_findings.disposition_and_acceptance: **Retain/adapt.** Session diagnostics use the durable physical EVSE/session association. Test explicit/automatic/unresolved assignment, restart, terminal counter settling and repeated finalization. Vehicle references are diagnostic/battery evidence, never a second grid contribution. Do not add a repair pipeline for mislabeled development-era diagnostics.

audit_findings.title: divergent accepted energy quality/unit contracts
audit_findings.disposition_and_acceptance: **Retain its qualification.** Share geometry/unit/association/quality validation with deliberate consumer strictness. Test valid estimates, wrong units, nulls, conflicts, missing phases, current-format recovery, permitted CSV imports and pending tails. Unsupported native development formats are rejected, not accepted as a compatibility category.

audit_findings.disposition: Implemented deliberate consumer qualification. Session energy requires physical source, kWh, valid interval geometry, complete phase cohort and admissible quality. Conflicting overlap clusters receive no credit; pending tails use the same quality contract. CSV remains a separate bounded import contract.

audit_findings.title: generic charging timing excludes C2
audit_findings.disposition_and_acceptance: **Resolve for both physical EVSEs.** Define per-charger and combined timing scope with correct overlap/coverage. Test either/both chargers, gaps, partial days and permitted CSV records with explicit limitations. Do not add pseudo-C2 history or transition fixtures. Keep “timing comparison, not proven controller savings.”
audit_findings.completion_evidence: See docs/audit/A01.md and named synthetic regressions; hardware verification has not occurred.

audit_findings.disposition: Implemented jointly with A07/A09. Physical C1 and C2 timing use each device’s actual intervals. Combined energy/cost and coverage use additive charger-time: one simultaneous hour on both devices is two charger-hours. Missing C2 history remains unknown. The result is a timing comparison, not causal savings.

audit_findings.title: clipped zero allowance invents exact capacity
audit_findings.disposition_and_acceptance: **Retain.** Propagate supply uncertainty through every planner fallback. With zero allowance, present property 30 A/phase and future non-EV load 14 A/phase, a 25 A budget remains compatible: only **7.59 kWh/hour** is then available. Do not certify 10 kWh using a reconstructed 30 A budget. Test one/all clipped phases, stale prior estimates, changed allocation/source and recovery. The new configured-fuse input is independent evidence, not permission to label an old inference exact.
audit_findings.completion_evidence: See docs/audit/A01.md and named synthetic regressions; hardware verification has not occurred.
audit_findings.clean_start_and_removal_notes: Current native formats only. Only v0.7.5 easee.csv/st-mq.csv import compatibility is preserved.
audit_findings.disposition: Implemented. Clipped allowance does not reconstruct an exact gross supply. Verified configured fuse-minus-margin is independent capacity evidence; uncertainty remains explicit otherwise.

audit_findings.title: quadratic long-session cost work
audit_findings.disposition_and_acceptance: **Retain; fix with A01-003.** Use canonical rates and efficient overlap integration or revision-aware incremental accrual. Keep output equivalent to an independent simple reference, including negative prices/gaps/corrections. Test 1/7/30/90-day sessions, including long idle periods and persisted recovery. Use operation-count/scaling assertions and realistic runtime/SQL measurements for budgets. Do not claim noisy pure-function timings prove end-to-end latency or missed charger actions.
audit_findings.completion_evidence: See docs/audit/A01.md and named synthetic regressions; hardware verification has not occurred.

audit_findings.disposition: Implemented canonical O(n log n) rate preparation and binary overlap integration. Independent numeric reference, 1/7/30/90-day overlap counts, 90-day SQL recovery and measured diagnostics replace a quadratic rate scan. Timings do not claim end-to-end charger action latency.

audit_findings.title: delayed start expires before final dispatch
audit_findings.disposition_and_acceptance: **Retain; audit evidence was static.** Revalidate the absolute occurrence, useful minimum pause, association, generation and authority after asynchronous persistence/auth steps and immediately before each real dispatch/retry. Distinguish definitely-unsent expired intent from a request that may have reached the provider. Add genuine installed-path fake-clock tests around `beforeWrite`, token persistence/refresh and 401 retry, plus midnight, DST fold/gap and authority loss. Do not assume provider behavior is a 24-hour rollover. Apply equivalent expiry/revision guards to Shelly queued commands and scheduled transitions.
audit_findings.completion_evidence: See docs/audit/A01.md and named synthetic regressions; hardware verification has not occurred.
audit_findings.clean_start_and_removal_notes: Current native formats only. Only v0.7.5 easee.csv/st-mq.csv import compatibility is preserved.
audit_findings.disposition: Implemented. Final Easee dispatch/retry checks absolute occurrence, minimum useful pause and authority after persistence/auth. Shelly intents carry expiry/revision/session scope and recheck before publish; definitely unsent expiry clears intent, possible dispatch reconciles.

audit_findings.title: old operational evidence confirms a new pause
audit_findings.disposition_and_acceptance: **Retain; audit evidence was static.** A fresh schedule readback plus an old noncharging mode/reason 54 does not establish the new pause. Require causally compatible physical evidence within the correct request/plug epoch, or remain unconfirmed. Test fresh charging mode, old/fresh waiting reasons, out-of-order fields, recovery and Equalizer-induced waiting. Extend the same distinction to Shelly: a successful Boolean/Number reply is not proof of physical current reduction. Do not advance execution/savings markers using stale confirmation.
audit_findings.completion_evidence: See docs/audit/A01.md and named synthetic regressions; hardware verification has not occurred.
audit_findings.clean_start_and_removal_notes: Current native formats only. Only v0.7.5 easee.csv/st-mq.csv import compatibility is preserved.
audit_findings.disposition: Implemented. Easee reason/mode source clocks must follow the specific schedule request; schedule readback alone cannot certify a physical pause. Shelly separately reports accepted/read-back/physical-effect and needs fresh actual current for the last stage.

audit_findings.title: late start/automatic OFF strands identification
audit_findings.disposition_and_acceptance: **Implement the explicitly expanded requirement.** Separate always-on passive observation and lifecycle invalidation from active-probe permission. Test Tesla and BMW on both chargers, native start hours after plug, automatic ON/OFF transitions and manual native windows. Unknown is not the other charger. A late valid assignment must reach UI, request/envelope and diagnostics together, without a new session or electrical rerouting. Do not make the old active-probe gate universally permissive merely to satisfy an observation test.
audit_findings.completion_evidence: See docs/audit/A01.md and named synthetic regressions; hardware verification has not occurred.
audit_findings.clean_start_and_removal_notes: Current native formats only. Only v0.7.5 easee.csv/st-mq.csv import compatibility is preserved.
audit_findings.disposition: Implemented. Always-on passive observation evaluates both EVSEs independently of economic enablement. Removed Tesla three-minute and BMW ten-minute-from-plug admission cutoffs; late fresh starts/stops remain scoped and usable. Ambiguity is preserved.

audit_findings.title: cross-source duplicate energy and unreconciled pre-ID prefix
audit_findings.disposition_and_acceptance: **Resolve by architectural removal.** Stop Tesla-derived canonical home-grid recording regardless of identity or automatic mode. Test equal-power independent EVSEs count twice, while one EVSE plus its vehicle feed counts once. Retain the 11 kW/minute, 15-second prefix and household-residual numerical witnesses as negative double-counting tests for the current architecture, not as a requirement for old-data correction. No obsolete ambiguity buffer, old-C2 rows or native-development repair ledger.
audit_findings.completion_evidence: See docs/audit/A01.md and named synthetic regressions; hardware verification has not occurred.
audit_findings.clean_start_and_removal_notes: Current native formats only. Only v0.7.5 easee.csv/st-mq.csv import compatibility is preserved.
audit_findings.disposition: Removed structurally. Deleted Tesla home-energy capture and its ambiguous pseudo-C2 path. The physical C2 adapter is the only current C2 producer. Equal physical powers can both contribute while a vehicle feed contributes zero electrical kWh.

audit_findings.title: unsent preflight consumes the experiment latch
audit_findings.disposition_and_acceptance: **Retain in the redesigned diagnostics.** A refused read/existing temporary restriction before dispatch is not an executed experiment. Retry clearly unsent transient preflight conditions with bounded backoff, preserving fresh permission/evidence checks. Once dispatch may have occurred, reconcile before another experiment. Cover safe later read, no-write timeout, before/after-dispatch authority loss, ambiguous result, persistent manual restriction, rapid updates, restart and unplug/replug. Do not “fix” this by resetting an attempted flag on every error.
audit_findings.completion_evidence: See docs/audit/A01.md and named synthetic regressions; hardware verification has not occurred.
audit_findings.clean_start_and_removal_notes: Current native formats only. Only v0.7.5 easee.csv/st-mq.csv import compatibility is preserved.
audit_findings.disposition: Retired active identification experiments instead of preserving their latch. Passive correlation and already-authorized native schedule pauses supply evidence; no current perturbation, probe API or probe ownership remains. Ordinary commands retain unsent/possibly-dispatched separation and bounded retry/reconciliation.

audit_findings.title: failed planning persistence poisons admission/fanout
audit_findings.disposition_and_acceptance: **Retain and extend to shared MQTT ingress.** Commit or roll back field values, sequence, live/retained admission bookkeeping and applicable clocks consistently. A failed first live value must not falsely suppress valid retained recovery. Isolate independently durable planning/recording projections or fan out from an accepted durable event. Test first/same-value failure, retained and later-live recovery, restart/reconnect, duplicates and pre-SUBACK replay. The audit's A05 root-owner label is a coordination note, not permission to omit the charger-relevant fix or fanout regression.
audit_findings.completion_evidence: See docs/audit/A01.md and named synthetic regressions; hardware verification has not occurred.
audit_findings.clean_start_and_removal_notes: Current native formats only. Only v0.7.5 easee.csv/st-mq.csv import compatibility is preserved.
audit_findings.disposition: Implemented. Tesla capture is one durable vehicle ingress with full field/sequence/live-admission rollback. BMW planning changes roll back associated assignment/revision state. Physical notification failures restore state and transport DUP admission so retry is possible.

audit_findings.title: old unscoped assignment survives a new epoch
audit_findings.disposition_and_acceptance: **Retain current association safety.** Validate association, epoch, scope and revision consistently across UI, vehicle envelope and diagnostics. Physical EVSE recording is independent of vehicle identity. Test current C1↔C2 sessions, native/manual restrictions, source-clock conflicts, reassociation, missed edges, restart and failed persistence. Do not import old unscoped verdicts or grant them current control/recording authority.
audit_findings.completion_evidence: See docs/audit/A01.md and named synthetic regressions; hardware verification has not occurred.
audit_findings.clean_start_and_removal_notes: Current native formats only. Only v0.7.5 easee.csv/st-mq.csv import compatibility is preserved.
audit_findings.disposition: Implemented. Current assignment carries association plus connection scope; unknown legacy verdicts cannot become current authority. Conflicts are latched until negative evidence clears them. UI request edits carry association/session/revision and cannot silently cross a cable change.

audit_findings.title: assignment discards vehicle native start/current constraints
audit_findings.disposition_and_acceptance: **Retain and extend to both physical chargers.** Assigned jobs must preserve the full applicable vehicle envelope. The existing native-start-two-hours-away versus one-hour/10 kWh deadline must remain constrained/infeasible, not confidently feasible. A known 6 A three-phase vehicle cap at 230 V supports **4.14 kWh/hour**, not 11.04. Test current and schedule changes, health/stale/retained evidence, manual/automatic modes, late identification, charger swap and restart. Do not solve this by writing the car's schedule/current or by merging three distinct scheduling authorities.
audit_findings.completion_evidence: See docs/audit/A01.md and named synthetic regressions; hardware verification has not occurred.
audit_findings.clean_start_and_removal_notes: Current native formats only. Only v0.7.5 easee.csv/st-mq.csv import compatibility is preserved.
audit_findings.disposition: Implemented. Applicable vehicle not-before/current/target ceilings feed both physical jobs. Known 6 A three-phase ceiling supports 4.14 kW at 230 V; a blocked native start remains infeasible before an earlier request deadline. No vehicle writes.

new_integrated_sequences.sequence: Tesla on C1/BMW on C2, then swap after real unplug/replug. Repeat each on either charger alone.
new_integrated_sequences.required_outcome: Correct scoped vehicle/request/envelope; electrical C1 always Easee and C2 always Shelly; no inherited session energy/ownership.
new_integrated_sequences.implementation: Runtime assignment on both chargers, actual cable-swap invalidation and physical-source accounting. Synthetic tests cover Tesla swaps and BMW on either EVSE; no physical two-car trial claimed.

new_integrated_sequences.sequence: Both cars connect together, similar powers, one or both native timers block draw for two hours.
new_integrated_sequences.required_outcome: Honest initial ambiguity/fallback; passive observer continues beyond three minutes; identification when evidence permits, including automatic OFF.
new_integrated_sequences.implementation: Equal-power ambiguity remains latched; delayed two-hour starts on either EVSE continue while automatic is OFF.

new_integrated_sequences.sequence: Visitor/unknown car; edit fallback SoC/capacity/target/deadline while connected; later obtain a known identity.
new_integrated_sequences.required_outcome: Immediate replan for edited default-derived/session fields; explicit session edits respected; whole connection remains one metered session.
new_integrated_sequences.implementation: Scoped session edits, preserved request identity, revision rejection and field-level vehicle precedence.

new_integrated_sequences.sequence: Both automatically scheduled, same deadline, enough cheap capacity.
new_integrated_sequences.required_outcome: Both use cheapest feasible periods; balanced progress rather than arbitrary FIFO; shared per-phase allocation respects minimum current.
new_integrated_sequences.implementation: Joint cash-cost candidate selection and bounded balanced allocation; exactness limited to enumerated synthetic cases.

new_integrated_sequences.sequence: Different battery sizes, SoC gaps, targets and deadlines; one car cannot start until later.
new_integrated_sequences.required_outcome: Fairness based on energy/eligible time and preserved envelope, not equal SoC/current or wall-clock time alone.
new_integrated_sequences.implementation: Native start/current ceilings and energy/eligible-time pressure in the joint planner.

new_integrated_sequences.sequence: Toggle C1→C2→balanced priority during charging and while commands await reply.
new_integrated_sequences.required_outcome: Immediate revision/reallocation; stale command cannot reverse it; no new session/manual reset; no Easee current command.
new_integrated_sequences.implementation: Runtime priority revision and serialized command supersession; queued old current cannot publish after a new allocation.

new_integrated_sequences.sequence: Priority charger could finish faster only with preference-driven more expensive energy.
new_integrated_sequences.required_outcome: Do not incur that premium; priority acts within feasible economic opportunities.
new_integrated_sequences.implementation: Priority never purchases an extra preference-only premium in independent synthetic scenarios.

new_integrated_sequences.sequence: Giving all shared cheap capacity to the priority vehicle would make an otherwise feasible secondary deadline fail.
new_integrated_sequences.required_outcome: Protect both deadlines using an explicit reservation; correct reason distinct from fuse limiting.
new_integrated_sequences.implementation: Joint planner reserves an achievable early secondary deadline before preference. Limiter reports priority reservation separately.

new_integrated_sequences.sequence: Both targets physically impossible before deadlines.
new_integrated_sequences.required_outcome: Priority mode maximizes preferred target fulfillment first and other second; balanced mode shares normalized shortfall without claiming feasibility.
new_integrated_sequences.implementation: Preferred target fulfillment in shortage and normalized shortfall fairness remain explicitly infeasible when appropriate.

new_integrated_sequences.sequence: Combined current supports one 6–10 A job but not two at ≥6 A.
new_integrated_sequences.required_outcome: Bounded fair time slicing; no invalid sub-6 A commands, starvation by logical ID or false progress.
new_integrated_sequences.implementation: Minimum-current feasible time slicing and bounded rotations; no sub-6 A RPC value.

new_integrated_sequences.sequence: Shelly priority; property total temporarily exceeds a fuse because Easee still draws, but non-Easee total fits.
new_integrated_sequences.required_outcome: Shelly not reduced for that total-current excursion; Equalizer sheds Easee; response/fault uncertainty visible.
new_integrated_sequences.implementation: Limiter subtracts actual Easee and own Shelly current to recover base load; property-total excursion alone does not lower Shelly. Actual Equalizer response remains hardware-unverified.

new_integrated_sequences.sequence: Non-Easee base load plus Shelly exceeds any phase's envelope, with/without Easee already paused.
new_integrated_sequences.required_outcome: Common Shelly cap from tightest phase; below minimum pauses; no overoptimistic phase averaging.
new_integrated_sequences.implementation: Asymmetric phase numerical witnesses select tightest phase; minimum-current boundary pauses.

new_integrated_sequences.sequence: Easee priority while house load rises; Shelly currently consumes capacity.
new_integrated_sequences.required_outcome: Proactive Shelly reservation change, read/settle/re-evaluate; no attempt to set Easee current or fight Equalizer.
new_integrated_sequences.implementation: Explicit planned reservation reduces Shelly only; no current-write method remains in Easee transport. Physical settling is observed rather than presumed.

new_integrated_sequences.sequence: Live load feed lost while Shelly controllable; manual-start, manual-stop and waiting-window variants.
new_integrated_sequences.required_outcome: Configured fallback ceiling (default 12 A) with explicit uncertainty; never start a stopped/waiting car merely because fallback was entered.
new_integrated_sequences.implementation: Configured 12 A fallback retains known tighter caps and manual/native permission. Manual-stop, native-schedule and lower native-current cases are covered.

new_integrated_sequences.sequence: Process/broker/device loss; last limit was greater than 12 A; restore on a different authority generation.
new_integrated_sequences.required_outcome: Actual autonomous behavior explicitly verified or marked unknown—not a fabricated 12 A application; stale commands fenced and live state reconciled before increase.
new_integrated_sequences.implementation: Authority/revision/disconnect fencing and uncertain readback reconciliation implemented. Autonomous outage fallback explicitly unverified; no synthetic result substitutes for hardware.

new_integrated_sequences.sequence: Manual start/stop/window from each app during plan/auth/readback, then priority changes/restart.
new_integrated_sequences.required_outcome: Connection-scoped authority preserved; no automatic restart after stop; manual window ends with a fresh plan; current protection remains active.
new_integrated_sequences.implementation: Easee finite native windows retain established handback. Shelly manual start/stop/current and native caps are preserved; any enabled native schedule conservatively owns start/stop until disabled/removed. Arbitrary cron windows are not guessed.

new_integrated_sequences.sequence: Vehicle reaches planning minimum but continues drawing; actual car ceiling differs from fallback target.
new_integrated_sequences.required_outcome: No target/deadline-only final stop; extra EVSE energy/cost recorded; continuing load reserved and unmet/unknown state honestly labeled.
new_integrated_sequences.implementation: Final release is open, post-target current stays reserved and metered, explicit target-versus-native-ceiling disagreement remains visible.

new_integrated_sequences.sequence: Long plug connection, multiple EVSE pause/resume sub-sessions, counter reset and transport reconnect.
new_integrated_sequences.required_outcome: One physical session; no counter double counting/lost cost; no stale owner or automatic repeat probe.
new_integrated_sequences.implementation: Physical plug session survives pauses; native accumulated counter reset/gap adds no fictitious delta. Current schema recovery preserves physical accounting and uncertain ownership.

new_integrated_sequences.sequence: Reject old native C2 databases/settings; initialize fresh physical EVSE state and explicitly import the two supported v0.7.5 CSV formats.
new_integrated_sequences.required_outcome: No obsolete pseudo-C2 writer, alias, ownership or state translation. Current restart works. CSV sources retain provenance and gaps without becoming Shelly measurements.
new_integrated_sequences.implementation: Strict settings/runtime/config boundaries reject old native pseudo-C2 shapes. Fresh schema and only the two specified CSV import formats remain.

new_integrated_sequences.sequence: Device/topic/root/phase association changes during an in-flight command or UI edit.
new_integrated_sequences.required_outcome: No write/energy/SoC borrowing across associations; old reply cannot validate new device; old history still queryable.
new_integrated_sequences.implementation: Device/source association and request/command revisions fence stale state, replies and edits; current-format history remains queryable.

conceptual_observations.required_treatment: Preserve explicit efficiency/usable-capacity assumptions, phase/observed-power contradiction diagnostics and conditional feasibility. Vehicle taper/temperature calibration is optional future work, not invented precision.
conceptual_observations.disposition: Preserved 0.925 efficiency and configured usable-capacity assumptions. Readiness is conditional; taper/temperature precision is not invented.

conceptual_observations.topic: OBS-B: asynchronous supply is not fuse measurement
conceptual_observations.required_treatment: Use coherent scoped live inputs for the new limiter; keep statistical forecast budget and physical fuse configuration separate. Test skew/clipping, not only simultaneous ideal tuples.
conceptual_observations.disposition: Live per-phase source clocks/skew and additive-model commissioning are explicit. Statistical forecast and configured fuse evidence are separate.

conceptual_observations.topic: OBS-C: timing metric is not causal savings
conceptual_observations.required_treatment: Preserve baseline/scope labels and separate actual, planned and comparison costs. No annual savings extrapolation from synthetic oracle cases. A full shadow-replay product remains optional.
conceptual_observations.disposition: Per-charger/combined timing are labeled comparison metrics; no causal or annual savings claim.

conceptual_observations.topic: OBS-D: later economic pauses need execution availability
conceptual_observations.required_treatment: Retain execution trace and unconfirmed/missed-transition diagnostics, honest outage behavior and final open release. Do not claim a multi-period plan was atomically installed when it was not.
conceptual_observations.disposition: Each native transition retains pending/confirmed execution. Later pauses require availability and the final release has no final stop.

conceptual_observations.required_treatment: **Superseded only for the physical C2 adapter.** Shelly is now an authorized actuator; Tesla is still read-only. Forecast, actionable command and hardware protection remain separate.
conceptual_observations.disposition: Superseded for physical Shelly C2 only. Tesla/BMW remain read-only; no vehicle or generic relay authority added.

conceptual_observations.required_treatment: Report current/CSV gaps, unpriced energy and reference-versus-grid scope. Current corrections rebase affected outputs explicitly; no repair layer or retained rows for obsolete native C2 history.
conceptual_observations.disposition: Physical grid/diagnostic references, missing/unpriced coverage and supported CSV limitations remain visible. No native-development data repair ledger.
